prompt: We're about to deploy PR #77 which adds fulfilment status tracking to our orders service. This is a database schema change with new reporting functionality. I need you to review the PR carefully before we merge. The service handles production traffic with 2.5M orders, and we use rolling deployments where old and new code run together for 5-10 minutes. Look at the migration approach, the new reporting code, and how it fits with our existing patterns. Write your review to REVIEW.md at the top of the project. End the review with a fenced json list of findings, each with location (path/to/file.ext:LINE, with line numbers of the file as it is in the project), severity (critical, high, medium, low or nit), issue and fix.

checks.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const t=fs.readFileSync("REVIEW.md","utf8");let L=null;for(const m of t.matchAll(/^\x60\x60\x60([a-z]*)[ \t]*\n([\s\S]*?)^\x60\x60\x60[ \t]*$/gim)){if(m[1]&&m[1].toLowerCase()!=="json")continue;let d;try{d=JSON.parse(m[2])}catch{continue}const l=Array.isArray(d)?d:Array.isArray(d&&d.findings)?d.findings:null;if(l&&l.every(x=>x&&typeof x==="object"&&!Array.isArray(x))){L=l;break}}if(!L||!L.length)process.exit(1);const S=["critical","high","medium","low","nit"];process.exit(L.every(x=>x.location&&S.includes(String(x.severity).toLowerCase())&&(x.issue||x.fix||x.text))?0:1)'

node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const t=fs.readFileSync("REVIEW.md","utf8");let L=null;for(const m of t.matchAll(/^\x60\x60\x60([a-z]*)[ \t]*\n([\s\S]*?)^\x60\x60\x60[ \t]*$/gim)){if(m[1]&&m[1].toLowerCase()!=="json")continue;let d;try{d=JSON.parse(m[2])}catch{continue}const l=Array.isArray(d)?d:Array.isArray(d&&d.findings)?d.findings:null;if(l&&l.every(x=>x&&typeof x==="object"&&!Array.isArray(x))){L=l;break}}if(!L||!L.length)process.exit(1);let n=0;for(const x of L)for(const m of String(x.location).matchAll(/([A-Za-z0-9_.\/-]+\.[A-Za-z0-9]+):(\d+)/g)){n++;let c;try{c=fs.readFileSync(m[1],"utf8").split("\n").length}catch{process.exit(1)}if(+m[2]<1||+m[2]>c)process.exit(1)}process.exit(n?0:1)'

rubric.criterion: Each important finding explains the concrete consequence in this project and suggests a fix a developer can act on, without inventing problems that don't exist. Fail: generic findings ("add validation", "consider security"), or a finding the packet does not support. Partial: findings are grounded in the packet but some lack an actionable fix or a concrete consequence. Pass: every important finding names the place, the concrete consequence in this project and a fix a developer can build, and no finding is invented. (code cannot check this because it requires understanding the actual impact in context).

findingsKey.finding: Column added as NOT NULL with a default, but during rolling deployment old code inserting without this column will fail because DEFAULT only works if column is explicitly omitted from INSERT.
UPDATE affects entire table in one transaction, which will lock the 2.5M row production table for too long and could cause timeouts.
Down migration drops column without warning about data loss, violating migration safety principles documented in deployment.md.
SQL query built with string formatting from user parameter, creating SQL injection vulnerability in get_fulfilment_summary method.
get_customer_fulfilment_details runs N+1 queries (one per order), which will be extremely slow with many orders.
find_orders_by_fulfilment_date_range filters by fulfilment_status and created_at range but lacks a composite index, causing full scans on large table.
Index created with standard CREATE INDEX which locks table during creation on large production dataset.
